title: Bill 87 extending temporary structure permits to five years
summary: A county engineering manager said on October 9 that temporary permits under the new ordinance last a maximum of five years. Bill 87 lets temporary structures allowed under an emergency proclamation stay up for up to five years. At the July 19 meeting, a testifier said Bills 87, 105 and 110 would help provide temporary housing.
